item.title: FMD outbreaks reshape economic outlook for South Africa’s livestock sector
item.description: According to analysis released by the Bureau for Food and Agricultural Policy (BFAP), the scale of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) infections recorded during 2025 has significantly altered earlier projections, shifting the livestock industry into what economists now describe as a high-disease-burden environment.

item.title: Diesel price drops by 50c
item.description: Lower international fuel prices and a stronger rand against the dollar have helped fuel prices decrease this month. This may bring some relief to farmers in the summer grain areas who are still busy planting.

item.title: FMD | Disease moves closer to Northern Cape border
item.description: There is concern that a potential outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease in the western Free State could lead to the disease spreading to the Northern Cape.

item.title: Motlhaping appointed new Northern Cape MEC for Agriculture
item.description: The Northern Cape Department of Agriculture, Environmental Affairs, Rural Development and Land Reform has announced a significant leadership change, with Lebogang James Motlhaping taking the helm as the new Member of the Executive Council (MEC) for the department.

item.title: FMD | ‘You have to shoot your own animals’
item.description: On day 44 of the foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in their Holstein dairy herd, the people of C. Nel Farming are feeling helpless, drained, discouraged and emotionally exhausted.

item.title: Global economic trends shaping local agriculture in 2026
item.description: The recent Nedbank Agriculture Webinar focused on South Africa’s agricultural outlook for 2026, informed by a review of the sector’s performance in 2025. Wandile Sihlobo, chief economist at the Agricultural Business Chamber (Agbiz), provided a macroeconomic perspective on the agricultural outlook. item.title: FS agriculture department expresses serious concern over declining biosecurity compliance among farmers
item.description: The Free State Department of Agriculture and Rural Development has raised the alarm about the declining adherence to critical biosecurity protocols among farmers in the province. This poses a significant threat of accelerated viral transmission to surrounding agricultural operations.

item.title: Widespread summer rain forecast for next week
item.description: Forecasts indicate that the summer rainfall pattern is beginning to shift further west, but a weather system from the second week of February could still bring widespread rain.
